title: ZymoBIOMICS MagBead DNA/RNA Protocol
author: ZYMO Research Corp.
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bktxkwpn

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample using DNA/RNA Shield and perform lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 µL DNA/RNA Shield A to a maximum of 250 µL input and mix and/or homogenize.
Optional: Store samples in DNA/RNA Shield at ambient temperature (4-25°C) for a month, 3 days at 37°C, or long-term (> 1 year) at -20°C or below.
Perform mechanical homogenization (e.g., using lysis tubes S6012-50 or lysis rack S6002-96-3) for unbiased lysis of different organisms.
Centrifuge to pellet debris and transfer 200 μl supernatant to a new tube.
Add 10 μl Proteinase K for every 200 μl sample, mix, and incubate at room temperature (20-30°C) for 30 minutes.
Add 200 µL DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer to the 200 µL sample and mix well.
Add 500 µL DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer to the sample and mix well.

steps.title: Bead Binding
steps.instruction: Bind nucleic acids to the magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL ethanol (95-100%) to the sample and mix well.
Add 30 µL ZymoBIOMICS MagBinding Beads (ensure beads are kept in suspension while dispensing) and mix well for 20 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Separation
steps.instruction: Separate RNA from the bead-bound DNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the plate/tube to the magnetic stand until beads (DNA) have pelleted.
Transfer the cleared supernatant (RNA) into a new plate/tube.

steps.title: DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Wash and purify the DNA bound to the beads.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the plate/tube to the magnetic stand until beads have pelleted, then aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant.
Add 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1, mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Add 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2, mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Add 500 µL ethanol (95-100%), mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Dry the beads for 10 minutes or until dry.

steps.title: DNase Treatment and Elution
steps.instruction: Treat with DNase I and elute the nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μl DNase I Reaction Mix and mix gently for 10 minutes.
Add 500 μl DNA/RNA Prep Buffer and mix well for 10 minutes.
Pellet the beads and discard the supernatant.
To elute DNA/RNA, add 50 μl ZymoBIOMICS DNase/RNase-Free Water and mix well for 5 minutes.
Transfer the plate/tube to the magnetic stand until beads have pelleted, then aspirate and dispense the eluted DNA/RNA to a new plate/tube.

steps.title: Secondary DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of washing and elution for DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1, mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Add 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2, mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Add 500 µL ethanol (95-100%), mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Dry the beads for 10 minutes or until dry.
Add 50 µL ZymoBIOMICS DNase/RNase-Free Water and mix well for 5 minutes.
Transfer the plate/tube to the magnetic stand until beads have pelleted, then aspirate and dispense the eluted DNA to a new plate/tube.

steps.title: RNA Recovery and Purification
steps.instruction: Recover and purify the RNA from the previously saved supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL ethanol (95-100%) to the supernatant and mix well.
Add 30 µL/well ZymoBIOMICS MagBinding Beads and mix well for 10 minutes.
Transfer the plate/tube to the magnetic stand until beads (DNA) have pelleted, then transfer the cleared supernatant (RNA) into a new plate/tube.
Add 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1, mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Add 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2, mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Add 500 µL ethanol (95-100%), mix well, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Add 50 μl DNase I Reaction Mix and mix gently for 10 minutes.
Add 500 μl DNA/RNA Prep Buffer and mix well for 10 minutes, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Dry the beads for 10 minutes or until dry.
Add 50 µL ZymoBIOMICS DNase/RNase-Free Water and mix well for 5 minutes.
Transfer the plate/tube to the magnetic stand until beads have pelleted, then aspirate and dispense the eluted DNA to a new plate/tube.
